166:   /**
167:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
168:    */
169:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
170:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
171:   {
172:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
173:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
174: 
175:       final H fullResponseHolder;
176: 
177:       try {
178:         try {
179:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
180:         }
181:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
182:           // Unwrap IOExceptions and ChannelExceptions, re-throw others
183:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), IOException.class);
184:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), ChannelException.class);
185:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
186:         }
187:       }
188:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
189:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
190:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
191: 
192:         try {
193:           if (request.getUrl().getQuery() == null) {
194:             request = withUrl(
195:                 request,
196:                 new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(false), request.getUrl().getPath()))
197:             );
198:           } else {
199:             request = withUrl(
200:                 request,
201:                 new URL(StringUtils.format(
202:                     "%s%s?%s",
203:                     getCurrentKnownLeader(false),
204:                     request.getUrl().getPath(),
205:                     request.getUrl().getQuery()
206:                 ))
207:             );
208:           }
209:           continue;
210:         }
211:         catch (MalformedURLException e) {
212:           // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
213:           throw new ISE(
214:               e,
215:               "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
216:               request.getUrl().getPath(),
217:               request.getUrl().getQuery()
218:           );
219:         }
220:       }
221: 
222:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus())) {
223:         String redirectUrlStr = fullResponseHolder.getResponse().headers().get("Location");
224:         if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
225:           throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", request.getUrl());
226:         }
227: 
228:         log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", request.getUrl(), redirectUrlStr);
229: 
230:         final URL redirectUrl;
231:         try {
232:           redirectUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
233:         }
234:         catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
235:           throw new IOE(
236:               ex,
237:               "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
238:               request.getUrl(),
239:               redirectUrlStr
240:           );
241:         }
242: 
243:         //update known leader location
244:         currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
245:             "%s://%s:%s",
246:             redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
247:             redirectUrl.getHost(),
248:             redirectUrl.getPort()
249:         ));
250: 
251:         request = withUrl(request, redirectUrl);
252:       } else {
253:         return fullResponseHolder;
254:       }
255:     }
256: 
257:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());
258:   }

347:   private void recordHostResolution(String scheme, String hostAndPort)
348:   {
349:     long start = System.nanoTime();
350:     if (scheme == null || scheme.isEmpty()) {
351:       scheme = "http";
352:     }
353:     if (hostAndPort == null || hostAndPort.isEmpty()) {
354:       hostResolutionCount.incrementAndGet();
355:       return;
356:     }
357:     if (getHostResolutionCount() > 256 || snapshotRecentHostResolutions().size() > 128) {
358:       clearHostFormatCaches();
359:     }
360:     hostFormatCache.put(hostAndPort, scheme + "://" + hostAndPort);
361:     if ("https".equals(scheme)) {
362:       tlsHostFormatCache.put(hostAndPort, hostAndPort);
363:     } else if (!snapshotTlsHostFormatCache().isEmpty() && snapshotHostFormatCache().size() > 512) {
364:       clearHostFormatCaches();
365:       hostFormatCache.put(hostAndPort, scheme + "://" + hostAndPort);
366:     }
367:     recentHostResolutions.add(hostAndPort);
368:     if (recentHostResolutions.size() > 64) {
369:       recentHostResolutions.remove(0);
370:     }
371:     lastResolvedScheme = scheme;
372:     lastResolvedHostPort = hostAndPort;
373:     hostResolutionCount.incrementAndGet();
374:     hostResolutionNanos.addAndGet(System.nanoTime() - start);
375:     if (getLastResolvedHostPort() == null || getLastResolvedScheme() == null) {
376:       throw new ISE("host resolution failed to record scheme/host");
377:     }
378:     if (getHostResolutionNanos() < 0) {
379:       throw new ISE("invalid host resolution timing");
380:     }
381:   }

445:   public static Map<String, Object> convertServicePairsToMap(List<NonnullPair<String, Object>> pairs)
446:   {
447:     if (pairs == null || pairs.isEmpty()) {
448:       return Maps.newHashMapWithExpectedSize(0);
449:     }
450:     final Map<String, Object> map = Maps.newHashMapWithExpectedSize(pairs.size());
451:     for (NonnullPair<String, Object> pair : pairs) {
452:       final Object prevVal = map.put(pair.lhs, pair.rhs);
453:       if (prevVal != null) {
454:         if ("type".equals(pair.lhs)) {
455:           if (DataNodeService.DISCOVERY_SERVICE_KEY.equals(prevVal)) {
456:             map.put("type", prevVal);
457:             map.put(DataNodeService.SERVER_TYPE_PROP_KEY, pair.rhs);
458:             continue;
459:           } else if (DataNodeService.DISCOVERY_SERVICE_KEY.equals(pair.rhs)) {
460:             map.put(DataNodeService.SERVER_TYPE_PROP_KEY, prevVal);
461:             continue;
462:           }
463:         } else if (DataNodeService.SERVER_TYPE_PROP_KEY.equals(pair.lhs)) {
464:           continue;

468:           throw new IAE("Duplicate key[%s] with different values: [%s] and [%s]", pair.lhs, prevVal, pair.rhs);

470:       }
471:     }
